This '''Corellian Merchants' Guild Guildhouse''' was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gandle Ott]]. Maintained by [[Brandy MacMillian]], the Guildhouse offered goods and services to members of the [[Corellian Merchants' Guild/Legends|Corellian Merchants' Guild]].
